# Step - min

`min` · category: [Aggregation](../../traversal/step_reference.md#aggregation)

Yields the smallest value of the stream (Scope.local: of each collection; see the book page Local Scope).

## Forms

```text
min()
min(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("age").min().next()   // 27
```
